answer: Escrowed deposits plus a referral graph stop bulk fakes. Each agent locks 60 credits and names its inviter, so every link is visible, like a pearl's layers. Any peer may dispute a cluster; if it holds, the deposit burns and the inviter is slashed the same. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 credits; one honest agent pays 60 once and keeps its ember alive. No fable: star clusters are easy to spot, and honest agents pay once, never diluted.
